title: Application of Intramolecular FlAsH-BRET to the Classification Arrestin Activation Modes
protocol: Maintain routine passage of HEK293 cells in 10 cm tissue culture plates or 75 cm² flasks using MEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 100 IU/mL penicillin and 100 IU/mL streptomycin.
Passage 90% confluent HEK293 cells into 6-well tissue culture plates at a seeding density that will attain approximately 50% confluence within 24 hours.
Combine 94 μL of plain MEM with 6 μL of FuGENE® HD transfection reagent in a sterile plastic 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Vortex to mix and pulse in a microfuge.
Allow the mixture to stand for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 1.0-1.5 μg of cDNA expression plasmid encoding the untagged GPCR of interest and 100-300 ng of one Rluc-arrestin3-FlAsH expression plasmid to each tube.
Flick tubes to mix and pulse in a microfuge.
Determine the optimal ratio of GPCR and Rluc-arrestin3-FlAsH expression plasmids empirically.
Allow the transfection mixture to stand at room temperature for 15 min.
Add the transfection mixtures to each well of a 6-well plate.
Return cells to the tissue culture incubator.
Incubate cells overnight at 37 °C.
Aspirate growth medium containing the transfection reagent from cells on Day 3 and discard.
Replace with 2 mL/well of MEM supplemented with 10% FBS, 100 IU/mL penicillin and 100 IU/mL streptomycin.
Return cells to incubator for overnight incubation at 37 °C.
On Day 4, aspirate growth medium from cells and discard.
Wash monolayers once with DPBS to remove serum.
Detach cells by adding 1 mL of DPBS containing 2 mM EDTA to each well.
Gently pipette cells and transfer to 1.5 mL microfuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g in a variable speed microcentrifuge for 3 min to pellet cells.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of HBSS.
Gently triturate several times using a 100-1000 μl single channel pipette to evenly disperse cells without lysing them.
Label the tetracysteine tag with FlAsH-EDT2 Labeling Reagent from the TC-FlAsHTM In-Cell Tetracysteine Tag Detection Kit.
Add 0.67 μL of FlAsH-EDT2 Labeling Reagent to each microfuge tube for a final concentration of 2.5 μM.
Gently invert tubes 4-5 times to mix the reagent thoroughly.
Label cells with FlAsH-EDT2 for 30 minutes at room temperature to ensure consistent results.
Discard used solutions as specified by Institutional guidelines for toxic waste.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g for 3 min to pellet cells.
Aspirate and discard the labeling medium.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of room temperature 1X BAL Wash Buffer diluted with HBSS.
Gently trititate several times using a pipette to evenly disperse cells without lysing them.
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g for 3 min to pellet cells.
Aspirate and discard the wash buffer.
Resuspend cells in 650 μL of BRET buffer.
Gently trititate several times using a pipette to evenly disperse cells without lysing them.
Reconstitute cells expressing each reporter as described in Steps 8.A.i-v.
Omit FlAsH-EDT2 Labeling Reagent from Step 8.A.i when preparing cells for measuring background BRET.
Transfer 100 μL of suspended cells into each well of an opaque white 96-well plate.
Ensure approximately 1.5 x 10^5 cells are transferred per well according to the experimental plate map.
Wrap the experimental plate in aluminum foil.
Keep the wrapped experimental plate in the dark at room temperature until ready for use.
Dilute ligand stocks to 12 times the desired final concentration in BRET buffer.
Prepare non-stimulated controls using the same dilution of ligand vehicle in BRET buffer.
Aliquot approximately 15 μL of 12X ligand per experimental well into PCR tube strips or round bottom 96-well drug plates.
Dilute the 2.2 mM stock coelenterazine solution to 12 times the desired final concentration (60 μM) in BRET buffer.
Transfer the 12X coelenterazine solution into PCR tube strips or round bottom 96-well drug plates for dispensing with a multi-channel pipettor.
Prepare the working solution of coelenterazine just before use and protect from light until needed.
Verify Rluc-arrestin3-FlAsH expression and tetracysteine tag labeling by measuring TC-FlAsH fluorescence with an excitation wavelength of 485 nm and emission wavelength of 530 nm.
Transfer 10 μL of 12X ligand from the PCR tube strips or round bottom 96-well drug plate to the corresponding wells in the experimental plate using a multi-channel pipettor.
Pipette up and down several times to ensure mixing of the ligand with the solution in the wells.
Change pipette tips between rows to avoid mixing ligands or cells expressing different reporters.
Pre-incubate cells with ligand for 0-10 min at room temperature before adding coelenterazine.
Transfer 10 μL of 12X coelenterazine solution from the PCR tube strips or round bottom 96-well drug plate to the corresponding wells in the experimental plate using a multi-channel pipettor.
Pipette up and down several times to ensure mixing of the coelenterazine with the solution in the wells.
Change pipette tips between rows.
Allow 2 min for Rluc emission to stabilize after adding coelenterazine.
Record 6 consecutive 1 sec readings of Rluc luminescence at 485 nm.
Record TC FlAsH fluorescence at 530 nm simultaneously with Rluc luminescence.
Calculate the BRET ratio using the instrument software.
Export BRET ratio data as a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.
Determine the mean of the 6 consecutive reads to obtain the average BRET ratio for each well.
Calculate the Net BRET ratio for each well by subtracting the mean background BRET ratio from cells lacking the BRET acceptor.
Determine the Δ Net BRET for each ligand-stimulated condition relative to vehicle-stimulated in the same experiment.
Plot the Δ Net BCRET observed upon ligand stimulation for each of the six Rluc-arrestin3-FlAsH reporters.
